patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Says he was abducted by aliens
clinical.quoteLong: They took me up on Tuesday. Very polite about it, gave me a cup of tea and brought me straight back. Why does everybody keep asking me what year it is?
clinical.presentationShort: 78yo M, no psychiatric history — 3 days new confusion and vivid narratives, urinary frequency, febrile. Family say the behaviour is entirely new.
clinical.presentationLong: 78-year-old male with no psychiatric history, three days of new-onset confusion and vivid narratives with urinary frequency and a low-grade fever; his family say this behaviour is entirely new for him.

diagnosis.primary: Delirium secondary to urinary tract infection
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → urinalysis and culture, bloods, IV antibiotics, likely admission
diagnosis.why: New psychosis after 60 is medical until proven otherwise. The tell is the fever, the three-day onset, and that the hat is NEW — a man does not simply become delusional at 78 without a cause. UTI, hypoglycaemia, hyponatraemia and medications all wear this costume.
diagnosis.redFlag: New 'psychiatric' symptoms at 78 with a fever — this is delirium until proven otherwise.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 78-year-old man in a cardigan wearing a home-made tin-foil hat, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting bolt upright on the edge of the seat, hands gripping his knees, checking the room behind him
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: physically well-kept but clearly not oriented
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 78-year-old man in a cardigan and slacks, wearing a home-made pointed hat crudely folded out of kitchen tin foil, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting bolt upright and alert on the edge of the seat, both hands gripping his knees, half-turned as though checking the room behind him. Expression: WILD-EYED - eyes wide and staring, brows raised high, utterly and urgently convinced of what he is saying. Clearly visible: a crumpled home-made tin-foil hat worn on the head; wide staring wild eyes; flushed cheeks. Overall: physically well-kept but clearly not oriented. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
